Results.ReviewText: Not as fancy as my previous Weber, but perfect for two plus a few guests
Results.Title: Good grill

Results.ReviewText:
I’ve had three or four Weber E-310 grills over the years plus a few of your kettle grills — on is sitting in my garage in case I want to use charcoal. All the grills have been great. Biggest question is how to make them last longer. I now live near the water off Kiawah Island and it’s tough here on metal. I know that I should cover it more than I do. 
From a cooking standpoint my new E-310 gas much better flame cont than the prior one… not sure why that one had such a high flame. This one is perfect. Tonight I’m grilling beer-brined pork chops with grilled veggies and tomorrow we’re fixing picanha (Brazilian style steak)  and are drooling just thinking about them!
Results.Title: Happy with my Weber E-310  grill

Results.ReviewText: Replaced an aged Genesis Series B so about the same size. The Spirit E-310 has a more uniform heating area(no hot spots) and I really like the cast iron grates instead of the steel. Igniter is also better. Quality seems as expected so hoping it last as long as my Genesis and bought a cover to hedge my bet.
Results.Title: 2nd Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText:
We have limited space on our small deck and did not want a grill that required an app on my phone!
Wanted a simple, easy to use grill that was versatile enough without all the bells and whistles.
This E-310 is exact right size and has everything I need.  I also purchased the griddle inserts which I have yet to use.
Results.Title: Versatile yet easy to use E-310

Results.ReviewText: The grill is more difficult to start than earlier models.  It seems to explode and I find it more dangerous.
Results.Title: review

Results.ReviewText:
Poor quality control.
Door arrived damaged and manifold (knob area) was broken.
Notified Weber of the problems but still waiting for resolution.
Results.Title: Grill poor quality control. Arrived damaged.

Results.ReviewText: Should’ve never bought another one after the first one rusted out, and Weber did not stand behind it
Results.Title: Rusty rust

Results.ReviewText: I've always had weber grills. I have always been very satisfied with the product and this one has not disappoint me. Love my new grill!!!!
Results.Title: Weber grills are exceptional

Results.ReviewText: The Weber grill has changed our summer for the best.
Results.Title: Weber Spirit 310

Results.ReviewText: The grill is fine. BUT the warranty service is terrible. Soon after my purchase the automatic igniter failed to work. It took more than 5 weeks to get it fixed going through the Weber customer service and then their service department. When I finally heard from the local serviceman Weber contacted to fix the problem he told me the next time I have an issue I should just call him directly to do the warranty work since Weber always drags out the process for weeks. My grill is now working but the wait was aggravating.
Results.Title: POOR WARRANTY SERVICE

Results.ReviewText: This is my 4th Weber. The first 3 were flawless. Unfortunately with this one, It’s challenging to keep the flame lit unless the grill is set on high. This makes cooking anything low and slow (chicken, vegetables, etc) impossible.
Results.Title: I guess I should have stopped at 3 Webers

Results.ReviewText: This is my 2nd Spirit! I had the 210 previously! It performs as advertised!
Results.Title: Performs as advertised!!

Results.ReviewText: My only complaint is that mice are getting into area behind door next to tank and onto shelves
Results.Title: Mice

Results.ReviewText: Love my new grill.  I’m using it much more than I did my last much larger grill.  The door on the front to get to the tank is much more convenient.
Results.Title: Grilling Daily!

Results.ReviewText: Had my first Weber gas grill for 30 years. It was too old to get replacement parts for, so why would I buy anything else than a new Weber?
Results.Title: My new Weber

Results.ReviewText: Since 1985 , this is my fourth Weber Grill. That says it all for the quality of the product. My last won I had for 15 years. On all three, the only part I had to replace was the rubber hose connecting to the propane tank. Outside, whether cover or uncover always worked. The previous one had a problem in the end with the starter and heating up. So after fifteen years what else would i purchase. Had a little problem with it the previous one, called weber, they help me fix with no  hassel. It was after 11 years.
Results.Title: Been a Weber customer for a long time.

Results.ReviewText: Awesome grill, easy to assemble, easy to clean, very happy with this purchase.
Results.Title: 5 stars

Results.ReviewText: After first couple use the cover changed color, not sure if this is normal, otherwise this grill is very good and easy to assemble.
Results.Title: Cover

Results.ReviewText: This rating is based on the poor assembly by Lowes; the scale was installed backwards, the dials are not properly set, and one is missing its logo.
Results.Title: Poor Assembly Detracts from the Overall Impression

Results.ReviewText: The grill works great, but the quality of the frame is horrible and not covered under the 10 year warranty. Parts are too expensive to be replaced, and not worth it. The base and sides were over $400.00
Results.Title: Not worth it anymore

Results.ReviewText: To me , this is the best I've ever owned ! I have purchased the full griddle insert also and with that said I don't need two separate units , great for small places . There are a few things that thee engineers at weber should design for this and all their grills . one would be adjustable casters as if you have the grill on a blacktop drive , they may be uneven as ours and adjustable casters would be great ! The other is as I stated I purchased a full griddle insert and when it is used you must take the grates out as the griddle fits in their place and vice versa ; It would be great for weber to design a storage for these items when they are not in use, other than that, 5 stars all day
Results.Title: THE BEST Kudos to WEBER !

Results.ReviewText:
It’s sleek, manageable weight.
The Propane tank sits in a compartment beneath the grill. There’s an actual gauge showing how much propane is left in tank.
Easy to operate, cooks evenly.
We are pleased with our purchase
Results.Title: Reliable Weber

Results.ReviewText: Mounting the propane tank is awkward and difficult. I realize that there is no base support due to the tank level gauge, but the mount is too hard to attach the tank to.
Results.Title: Great except for tank mount

Results.ReviewText: Really good grill for the price, good heat dispersion. Only issue is that the the handle to open the cover and both shelves become very hot during cooking
Results.Title: Good price value

Results.ReviewText: I couldn’t be happier with my Spirit E-310 Propane Grill. This grill has everything that I was looking for. From the enclosed easy access tank location to the super heavy duty cast iron grill plates to the 3 very controllable burners. I swore up and down that I would never buy a propane grill because I have always cooked on a Weber Kettle grill using mesquite coals and If it ain’t broke why fix it. I finally had to give in though, I live in the San Bernardino County Mountains Community of Crestline and my wonderful neighbors like calling the Fire Department every time I would light up my Weber Kettle Grill because of the smoke that the coals give off would trigger a freak out from my neighbors. So I gave in and purchased a Weber propane grill and now I am bbq’ing all hours of the morning, day and night and my neighbors only get to enjoy the wonder smell of cooking meat and the S.B. County Fire Department is no longer coming out to my house. It really is nice to just last minute decide to bbq burgers and not have to hassle with the lengthy time of waiting for my coals to be ready to cook on or have to drive down the mountain to a 24 hour Walmart at 10 pm just so I can bbq and enjoy the midnight sky. This grill sips the propane giving many many cooks before a tank refill. Best decision I ever made, definitely 2 thumbs up.
Results.Title: BBQ 24/7

Results.ReviewText: Relatively easy to assemble. Heat controls simple to use and provides even heat through out. Have successfully cooked steak, chicken, ribs and vegetables thus far.
Results.Title: Pleased BBQer

Results.ReviewText: Outstanding grill. Quality built grill. Wouldn't expect anything less from Weber
Results.Title: Weber Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: I absolutely love my new grill. It seems to be very well made. Was packaged beautifully
Results.Title: Love my new Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: My last Weber lasted about 12 years. I replaced it with the same model because it’s not too big for my patio, but big enough to handle indirect heating needs. No other grill will do for me!
Results.Title: The one grill you need!

Results.ReviewText: Solid grill. Works well. Far burner takes some time at times to light. Appreciate the parts warranty, especially for the burner parts.
Results.Title: Weber Espirit Review

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
